page0.text:
It's getting late.
After dinner, I went to the dojo with Saber to receive punishment—Saber called it training, but I swear she was just bullying me—and when we finished, it was past 10 PM.
The three of them are rooming together again, and Fuji-nee and Sakura already turned in.

page1.text:
"Shirou...? What is it? Are you not returning to your room?"
"Hm...? Yeah, I'll go. But there's something I wanted to ask you before that."

page2.text:
"Is something bothering you? Please go ahead, I will answer anything I can."
...

page3.text:
...I guess I should get straight to the point.
What Archer said...
Servants, who have no freedom, desire the Holy Grail to obtain freedom...
Saber should be the same, but he said that she doesn't seek freedom.

page4.text:
"...Saber. You need the Holy Grail, right?"
"...Yes. My objective is to obtain the Holy Grail. I became a Heroic Spirit for that reason. I believe I told you this before."

page5.text:
"I know. But, for what?
Servants who obtain the Holy Grail can stay in this world without a Master, right?
Then...you're going to obtain the Holy Grail and do what you wanted to do here, right?"

page6.text: "...No. I will leave this world after obtaining the Holy Grail. It will not be permitted for me to stay here since I am not from this world, and most of all, I do not have anything that I want to do."

page7.text:
Her eyes are determined.
There's absolutely no hesitation or deceit in them, and no room for me to argue the point.

page8.text: "...I see. I can't say anything since I don't know what your objective is, but..."

page9.text:
...Well, I'm starting to think that it's unlike Saber to ask for a wish from the Holy Grail.
I don't know what the Holy Grail is.
But I have a feeling deep down that it isn't the sort of thing this golden-haired girl ought to pursue.

page10.text:
"...But I did promise that we'd obtain the Holy Grail...I'll believe your words for now."
"Is something wrong, Shirou? You have not seemed well ever since you came home."

page11.text:
"That's not true... Oh yeah. Saber, about our plans moving forward..."
Saber looks serious again.
As expected of her. No matter how close she gets with Fuji-nee, Saber is still Saber.
It's annoying, but just as Archer said, fighting is her true nature.

page12.text: "I went to school today and found out that there's a third Master... Um, then I had a quarrel with Tohsaka. A lot happened, and then we ended up settling on a truce until we find the Master hiding at our school..."

page13.text:
In a rush, I report what happened.
Saber was listening with a serious face at first, but as the story went on...
She started looking at me in dissatisfaction.

page14.text:
"...Hm. Saber, are you opposed to cooperating with Tohsaka?"
"No. I agree with learning from Rin as you have little knowledge.
However, if you make such important decisions, you must tell me right away. Consulting me beforehand would have been preferrable as well."
With reproach in her tone, Saber stares me down.
...I'm ashamed of myself since she's absolutely right.

page15.text:
"Then, you will cooperate with Rin to search the school starting tomorrow?"
"I guess that's how it'll be. I'll call for you if we find something odd, so stand by here until then."

page16.text:
"...Hmm. It is too lenient of a plan, but it will be perfect until you get used to battle.
So for the time being, we will be going after the Master that set up the Bounded Field at school?"
I nod.
After thinking for a bit...
